top_offers.title: Hands-on CTO — AI-First Engineering
top_offers.why: CTO-level ownership with a hands-on, AI-first mandate maps directly onto Magino's cofounder background and current focus on AI-augmented engineering. Fully remote with EU-friendly flexibility partially offsets the lack of a Geneva base, and comp is solid for a remote role.

top_offers.title: Founding Engineer (Senior/Staff)
top_offers.why: A true 0-to-1 founding role with mission-driven healthcare impact, echoing the Alaya build-from-scratch experience. Compensation is strong but the role is US-remote only, a step down from Geneva/EU on location fit.

top_offers.title: Founding Engineer
top_offers.why: Strong technical and AI-stack overlap plus genuine founding-engineer scope, but the team requires in-person collaboration in San Francisco, which conflicts with Geneva-based location preference and is the main drag on the score.

top_offers.title: Staff Platform Engineer, Infrastructure
top_offers.why: Staff-level platform ownership at a high-growth AI product company is a strong technical and seniority fit, tempered by an uncertain remote policy and US timezone base.
